# --quiet still reports errors, with the output and messages of the target
# that failed, but nothing from targets that succeeded.
! bit -q
stdout '^ *task ▶ echo out; echo ::error::bad; false$'
stdout '^ *task │ out$'
stdout '^ *task ✘ bad$'
stdout '^ *task ✘ .*exit'
! stdout 'fine'
! stdout 'quiet_ok'
stderr 'error:'

! bit --quiet --schema missing
! stdout .
stderr 'unknown resource/function'

-- BUILD.bit --
quiet_ok = exec { command = "echo fine" }

task = exec {
  command = "echo out; echo ::error::bad; false"
  after = [quiet_ok]
}
